name: Lavalink (Chilly)
author: hey@codemeapixel.dev
description: Lavalink v4 audio node configured for Chilly: youtube-source with the TV OAuth client and a remote yt-cipher server, LavaSrc and LavaSearch. The built-in YouTube source is disabled.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

mkdir -p /mnt/server/plugins /mnt/server/logs
cd /mnt/server

if [ -z "${LAVALINK_VERSION:-}" ] || [ "${LAVALINK_VERSION}" = "latest" ]; then
  LAVALINK_VERSION=$(curl -fsSL https://api.github.com/repos/lavalink-devs/Lavalink/releases/latest | sed -n 's/.*"tag_name": *"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p' | head -n1)
fi

echo "Installing Lavalink ${LAVALINK_VERSION}"
curl -fL --retry 3 -o Lavalink.jar.new "https://github.com/lavalink-devs/Lavalink/releases/download/${LAVALINK_VERSION}/Lavalink.jar"
mv Lavalink.jar.new Lavalink.jar

YOUTUBE_SNAPSHOT=false
if [[ "${YOUTUBE_PLUGIN_VERSION}" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{7,40}$ ]]; then
  YOUTUBE_SNAPSHOT=true
fi

rm -f plugins/youtube-plugin-*.jar plugins/lavasrc-plugin-*.jar plugins/lavasearch-plugin-*.jar

if [ -f application.yml ]; then
  cp application.yml "application.yml.bak"
  echo "Backed up the existing application.yml to application.yml.bak"
fi

cat > application.yml <<EOF
server:
  port: 2333
  address: 0.0.0.0
  http2:
    enabled: false

lavalink:
  plugins:
    - dependency: "dev.lavalink.youtube:youtube-plugin:${YOUTUBE_PLUGIN_VERSION}"
      snapshot: ${YOUTUBE_SNAPSHOT}
    - dependency: "com.github.topi314.lavasrc:lavasrc-plugin:${LAVASRC_VERSION}"
      snapshot: false
    - dependency: "com.github.topi314.lavasearch:lavasearch-plugin:${LAVASEARCH_VERSION}"
      snapshot: false
  server:
    password: ""
    sources:
      youtube: false
      bandcamp: true
      soundcloud: true
      twitch: true
      vimeo: true
      nico: true
      http: true
      local: false
    bufferDurationMs: 400
    frameBufferDurationMs: 5000
    opusEncodingQuality: 10
    resamplingQuality: LOW
    trackStuckThresholdMs: 10000
    useSeekGhosting: true
    playerUpdateInterval: 5
    gc-warnings: true

plugins:
  youtube:
    enabled: true
    allowSearch: true
    allowDirectVideoIds: true
    allowDirectPlaylistIds: true
    clients:
      - MUSIC
      - TV
      - ANDROID_VR
      - WEB
      - WEBEMBEDDED
    oauth:
      enabled: true
      refreshToken: ""
    remoteCipher:
      url: ""
      password: ""
      userAgent: "chilly"
  lavasrc:
    providers:
      - 'ytsearch:"%ISRC%"'
      - "ytsearch:%QUERY%"
    sources:
      spotify: false
      applemusic: false
      deezer: false
      youtube: false
    spotify:
      clientId: ""
      clientSecret: ""
      countryCode: "US"
      playlistLoadLimit: 6
      albumLoadLimit: 6

logging:
  file:
    path: ./logs/
  level:
    root: INFO
    lavalink: INFO
  request:
    enabled: true
    includeClientInfo: true
    includeHeaders: false
    includeQueryString: true
    includePayload: false
  logback:
    rollingpolicy:
      max-file-size: 50MB
      max-history: 7
EOF

echo "Lavalink ${LAVALINK_VERSION} installed with youtube-plugin ${YOUTUBE_PLUGIN_VERSION}, lavasrc ${LAVASRC_VERSION}, lavasearch ${LAVASEARCH_VERSION}"

variables.name: Lavalink Version
variables.description: Lavalink release tag to install, for example 4.2.2, or latest. Reinstall the server to apply a change.

variables.name: YouTube Plugin Version
variables.description: youtube-source plugin version. A release number such as 1.18.2, or a commit hash to use a snapshot build. Reinstall the server to apply a change.

variables.name: LavaSrc Version
variables.description: LavaSrc plugin version. Reinstall the server to apply a change.

variables.name: LavaSearch Version
variables.description: LavaSearch plugin version. Reinstall the server to apply a change.

variables.name: Server Password
variables.description: Password clients use to connect. Must match NODE_PASSWORD in the bot's environment. Use a long random value.

variables.name: YouTube OAuth Refresh Token
variables.description: Refresh token for the TV client. Leave empty on first start to run the device sign-in flow, then copy the token from the console here.

variables.name: Cipher Server URL
variables.description: Base URL of the yt-cipher server, for example http://10.0.0.5:8001.

variables.name: Cipher Server Token
variables.description: API_TOKEN configured on the yt-cipher server.

variables.name: Enable Spotify
variables.description: Enable the LavaSrc Spotify source. Requires the client ID and secret below.
